subject.title: fix(reef): bound inbox websocket open waits at 30s

question: Should Reef inbox WebSocket upgrade attempts fail closed after a fixed private 30-second wait before entering the existing reconnect backoff?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but source and tests cannot decide the acceptable maximum Reef handshake latency or whether slow upgrades should be terminated unconditionally.

options.title: Accept 30-second bound
options.body: Keep the private 30-second timeout and merge after refreshing the branch because it prevents indefinite reconnect stalls without adding configuration surface.

options.title: Choose another bound
options.body: Retain the implementation shape but adjust the private timeout and focused assertions to a Reef-owner-approved duration.

options.title: Keep waits unbounded
options.body: Do not merge if Reef relays intentionally permit arbitrarily slow WebSocket upgrades despite the reconnect-loop availability cost.

recommendation.title: Accept 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Keep the private 30-second timeout and merge after refreshing the branch because it prevents indefinite reconnect stalls without adding configuration surface.
